fundamental_inputs.base_note: Rounded H1 drug-sales disclosure times two is a computational base, NOT an assertion of FY2026 sales; non-innovative residual is not claimed to equal a separately audited generic-drug segment. Three compounding periods to normalized FY2029.

valuation_bases.model_name: Hengrui external research sensitivity; NOT accepted full rNPV

other_explicit_inputs.countercase: Innovation growth need not improve profit. Approvals need pricing/access. BD is contingent. FDA manufacturing and oral GLP-1 tolerability risks remain.
coverage_limits: Full H1 notes unavailable: licensing recognition/receipts, nonrecurring detail, working capital and distributable cash not reconciled.
No asset-level risk-adjusted NPV; omitted NewCo equity and net cash are not asserted worthless. No separate BD headline addition.
Licensing inputs are normalized after-tax annual profit assumptions, excluding disposal/revaluation gains.
No dividends, future dilution, taxes or transaction costs modeled.
Same-assistant bounded self-review only. Native Deep/Claim Audit v1/independent review/Human acceptance NOT_RUN.
other_explicit_inputs.numerical_provenance: Sales/share: HENGRUI:2026-H1:RESULTS-RELEASE. Share count: HENGRUI:2026-08:SHARE-MONTHLY-RETURN. 2=half-year annualization;3=years;100=percentage conversion. Growth/margins/licensing/PE/probabilities are explicit assumptions.

valuation_parameter_inputs.probability_note: 30/50/20 are uncalibrated subjective diagnostic weights. Native Odds measures these exact assumptions, not their empirical correctness.
